name: Offagna (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, blue and yellow, the blue charged with the crowned municipal arms of Offagna (red, blue and yellow pales) within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI OFFAGNA in white arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Offagna, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Offagna arms — red, blue and yellow pales, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI OFFAGNA arched above the arms
